fact: Collateral is deposited per network and asset, including DAI and sDAI on Ethereum and xDAI or wxDAI/sDAI on Gnosis.
Outcome tokens can be minted, merged, and redeemed as part of the position lifecycle.
Trading is a distinct app flow for buying and selling outcome tokens.
Liquidity provision is a first-class app function separate from trading.
Seer supports specialized market types beyond standard markets, including conditional and futarchy markets.
The app includes a leaderboard and Trader Score for user performance tracking.
The whitepaper attributes prior prediction market failures to causes including lack of liquidity and regulatory attacks.
Seer's proposed practical implementation combines an AMM with auctions.
The Seer solution defines market roles and economics via prediction market actors, information seekers, token incentives, and safe liquidity provision.
Developer guides cover creating and resolving markets, split/merge/redeem, conditional and futarchy markets, trading outcome tokens, and multi-primary collateral profiles.
